subject: RapidBridge integration outage - coordinating support & SLA next steps
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@rapidbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RapidBridge->Redwood integration failing (500s) - urgent

Marcus —

We started seeing 500/502 responses from the Redwood integration that backs our 'generate_summary' webhook at ~08:45 PST this morning. The error rate peaked around 09:00 and affected ~40% of incoming requests for a ~25 minute window. We rolled back our client-side SDK changes but errors persisted. Logs attached (rb-debug-log-20261130.txt).

Key impact: customers on our paid tier saw delayed responses and several timeouts; we have a support queue building. We need an ops contact at Redwood to coordinate a remediation window and understand if this counts as an SLA breach for the integration (our contract references response success >= 99.5% for the production route).

Can you point us to who will triage and whether Redwood can perform an immediate routing rollback or failover to the previous model variant? We are happy to open a conference bridge.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, RapidBridge
ops@rapidbridge.com

Attachment: rb-debug-log-20261130.txt (plain text, 42KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@rapidbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RapidBridge->Redwood integration failing (500s) - urgent

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the logs. Looping in Camila (partner lead), Jonas (inference eng) and Laura (CS) to triage.

Immediate plan:
- Jonas: can you confirm whether this maps to yesterday's routing policy rollout (model-variant routing by cost tier)? If so we should revert routing to the prior variant for the RB production route.
- Camila/Laura: please prepare a one-page customer update for RapidBridge customers and set expectation for a 2-hour maintenance window if we need to revert.
- Samir: is RapidBridge able to schedule a maintenance window in the next 30-60 minutes? If not, we can do a short targeted rollback without a full maintenance announcement.

I attached the latest integration runbook we use for partner handoffs (integration-runbook-v2.pdf) — it has the rollback steps and contact numbers for on-call infra.

We'll treat this as a priority incident and create a JIRA (RBINT-412). Jonas, please add estimated MTTx and confirm if DB/key-cache invalidation is required.

Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RapidBridge->Redwood integration failing (500s) - urgent

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 9:22 AM Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samir — thanks for the heads up and the logs. Looping in Camila (partner lead), Jonas (inference eng) and Laura (CS) to triage.

Thanks — I dug into the logs Samir attached. Summary: the request fanout hit our model routing gateway where a new routing rule (deployed 11/29) incorrectly matched a subset of RB requests due to a header-parsing edge case; the gateway attempted to route to a lower-capacity variant which then returned 502s under burst load. The issue is deterministic and reproducible in staging.

Remediation plan (proposed, ETA ~20-30 minutes):
1) Revert routing rule on the RB route to previous stable variant (rollback in control plane).
2) Warm up the stable variant instances to avoid cold-start tail latency (pre-warm script run, ~10 minutes).
3) Monitor error rate for 30 minutes; keep sampling via the RB integration test harness.

I'll open RBINT-412 with full triage notes and attach a patch for the header parser. I will need infra on standby to perform revert (permission/owner: infra-oncall).

If we decide not to rollback, the other option is to increase concurrency on the lower-capacity variant, but that risks impacting cost and doesn't address the routing mismatch root cause.

-Jonas
Lead, Inference Platform
jonas@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@rapidbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RapidBridge->Redwood integration failing (500s) - urgent

Marcus / team — thanks for the quick responses. We can carve a 30-minute maintenance window at 10:30 PST to coordinate a rollback if Redwood prefers a scheduled window. If you opt for a quick rollback without customer notification we can accept that as well but will need a short status note for our CS queue.

Two asks from RapidBridge:
- Please confirm whether this incident will be treated as a contractual SLA incident (we will file a claim for credits if the platform-side availability fell below the agreed threshold during the event).
- We would like a joint post-mortem within 72 hours with a short action plan to prevent recurrence (header parse regression + rollout gating).

We can join the bridge at 10:25 PST. My mobile is +1 617-555-0148.

Samir
Head of Integrations, RapidBridge

Links: HubSpot Deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/5498
Attachment: rb-debug-log-20261130.txt (included previously)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 17:34:00 -08:00
Subject: RapidBridge incident - decision & next steps

Team — finalizing notes after the rollback and monitoring window yesterday. TL;DR: Jonas reverted the routing rule per plan, error rate fell to baseline within 12 minutes of the rollback. RapidBridge confirmed customer impact but accepts the 10:30 quick maintenance window.

Decisions / agreed actions:
- Customer credit: approve a one-month pro-rata credit for impacted customers under RB deal RB-7834 (Camila / Laura to own the customer communication and credit calculation).
- Post-mortem: schedule a joint incident review with RapidBridge (Samir) for 2026-12-03 11:00 PST. Jonas will present the technical root cause and the patch; Camila will lead remediation/rollout gating changes.
- Preventative work: create an automated rollout gate for routing-rule changes (testing against partner header permutations) and add a canary step for partner routes. JIRA RBINT-412 will track EPIC and sub-tasks.

Camila/Laura: please confirm the credit amount and share the customer-facing note by EOD tomorrow. Jonas: drop the patch and test notes into RBINT-412 and add the runbook snippet to the shared Drive folder.

Thanks all — good coordination. I'll join the post-mortem with the RapidBridge execs.

Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Forwarded message: see thread above for logs and attachments.
